title: Use contraction and a nonphysical linear fit without inventing a stronger Choi floor
statement: Choose b=min(B,ceil(nu^-1)), G=E^b and gamma_b=1-(1-nu)^b. Ordinary process tomography to eta=epsilon*gamma_b/4, a Hermiticity/trace-preserving linear fit, its trace-one affine fixed point, then negative-eigenvalue clipping/renormalization give error<=2eta/(gamma_b-eta). The fitted map need not be physical. Each observation costs b actual calls. The proof uses improved trace contraction; it does NOTclaim that J_(E^b)has depolarizing floor gamma_bor supply labelled reset/Fports.
